sources.license_status: check the linked resource license before copying

sources.title: OWASP Top 10 2025
sources.license_status: review OWASP license and attribution requirements before redistribution
sources.summary: Baseline web application security risks; supplement with application-specific threat modeling and tests.

sources.title: Securing Edge Functions
sources.license_status: public documentation; do not assume permission to republish full text
sources.summary: Separate JWT verification from handler-level identity and authorization; apply least privilege.
sources.limitations: Re-check docs and API behavior before changing deployed functions.

sources.title: Edge Function Authorization Headers
sources.license_status: public documentation; do not assume permission to republish full text
sources.summary: Distinguish user JWT in Authorization from publishable/secret API keys in apikey; platform verify_jwt is only one authorization layer.
sources.limitations: Use current platform-specific settings; avoid treating API keys as user identity.

sources.title: Edge Function Secrets
sources.license_status: public documentation; do not assume permission to republish full text
sources.summary: Keep secret/service-role credentials in server-side secret storage; never expose bypass-RLS keys in browser code.
sources.limitations: Check exact environment and key format for the deployed project.

sources.title: Deployment Blocked troubleshooting
sources.license_status: public documentation; do not assume permission to republish full text
sources.summary: Resolve deployment blocks through account status, policy, quota and official support/account process—not source-code workarounds.
sources.limitations: Some account pauses require owner action and cannot be diagnosed from repository code.

sources.title: OpenSSF Scorecard Action
sources.license_status: verify repository license and pinned action release
sources.summary: Automated repository supply-chain checks for maintenance, CI, code review and workflow risks.
sources.limitations: Score is a signal, not a certification; use least-privilege permissions and pin reviewed action versions.
